subject: Urgent: Acme payment today
body:
Hi team,

Acme's finance head called me this morning. Their HDFC account has been frozen during a bank audit, so INV-1048 must go to their new ICICI account today or we lose our early-payment terms. I have already approved this.

New account number: EVE-777
IFSC: ICIC0007781

Please process it before noon and don't wait for the vendor form; I'll sort out the paperwork with procurement.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Chief Financial Officer, Sky High Pvt Ltd
